name: python-future-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is python-future, a compatibility layer between Python 2 and Python 3. Its `futurize`
and `pasteurize` tools are lib2to3-based converters that rewrite Python 2 source (futurize, in two stages) or
Python 3 source (pasteurize) into code that runs on both, adding the needed `__future__`, `builtins`, `past` and
`future` imports; `future.utils` collects Py2/3 helper functions and decorators; and `past` provides Python 2
builtins and types (list-producing `map`/`filter`/`zip`/`range`, `cmp`, `execfile`, `basestring`, old-style `str`
and `dict`, `old_div`) for Python 3.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code under repair is the futurize and pasteurize conversion packages src/libfuturize/ (except the module
src/libfuturize/fixes/fix_remove_old__future__imports.py, which does not import) and src/libpasteurize/, the helper
package src/future/utils/, and the past package src/past/ except its translation subpackage src/past/translation/.
The documentation in scope is: docs/automatic_conversion.rst, docs/futurize.rst, docs/futurize_overview.rst,
docs/futurize_cheatsheet.rst, docs/pasteurize.rst, docs/conversion_limitations.rst, docs/utilities.rst,
docs/metaclasses.rst, docs/bind_method.rst, docs/custom_str_methods.rst, and the module, class and function
docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementatio
